episodes.synopsis: Luciana Rudleberg, the count's daughter, was a huge mess until one maid named Melody came to accept the job.
episodes.title: The Girl Who Wanted to Be a Maid

episodes.synopsis: Getting used to her new job, Melody goes to town to gather food, when she runs into another maid.
episodes.title: At This Moment, a Maid's Superiority Is About to Unfold

episodes.synopsis: Melody finds an escort for Luciana, but she ends up going herself?! With her father there, what will she do?
episodes.title: Two Girls Proceed to the Royal Castle

episodes.synopsis: Things begin to heat up as Luciana starts sensing malicious gazes from people at the ball, but who and why?
episodes.title: The Truth Beneath the Moonlight

episodes.synopsis: With Melody away from the castle, will Christopher and Anna-Marie be able to save Luciana from the Dark One?!
episodes.title: Sudden Seriousness

episodes.synopsis: As the scenario continues to change, Anna-Marie makes it her mission to find out the cause only to find out...
episodes.title: The House of Rudleberg's All-Works Maid

episodes.synopsis: After learning of her mistake, Anna-Marie decides to take a breather by secretly heading to town, when...
episodes.title: Anna-Marie's Exciting Day-Off Date

episodes.synopsis: First day of school is finally here. Having a mixed reputation, will Luciana and Melody make any friends?
episodes.title: A New Encounter at the Royal Academy

episodes.synopsis: While Luciana's school life appears to be going well, Melody finds herself bored as she questions her purpose.
episodes.title: A Knight's Reunion and the Wavering Pride of a Maid

episodes.synopsis: With events derailing from the game, the reincarnators try to gather clues to see who the Jealous Witch is.
episodes.title: The Jealous Witch Incident

episodes.synopsis: Students begin to accuse Luciana, as another incident occurs. Will they manage to find the jealous witch?
episodes.title: The Choice the Ladies Make
